# Veilus
> Anti-detect browser with built-in automation platform. Native Chromium engine — 3x faster, 80% less RAM.

## Key Facts
- Free tier: 5 browser profiles forever, no credit card required
- Native engine built with Tauri + Rust (not Electron)
- Each profile has a unique fingerprint: Canvas, WebGL, AudioContext, Client Hints (20+ parameters)
- Built-in automation: Playwright scripts written by you or your AI assistant via MCP
- End-to-end encrypted sync via Git or Google Drive
- Currently available on macOS; Windows and Linux expected Q2 2026

## Core Features
- Fingerprint Engine: 20+ browser parameters customized per profile
- VeilusFlow: Write Playwright scripts yourself or via your AI assistant over MCP; run across profiles in batch or on schedule
- Visual Canvas: Drag-and-drop automation flow builder (low-code)
- VeilusSync: Hierarchical end-to-end encrypted profile sync
- Scheduling: Hourly/daily/weekly automation with missed-run catch-up

## Pricing
- Free: 5 profiles, 1 device, latest browser engine; no Veilus Flow, scheduling, batch runs or local API/MCP
- Monthly: 200,000 VND or $9 per device per month
- Lifetime (one-time): Solo 1 device 2,500,000 VND / $99; Team 5 5,000,000 VND / $199; Team 10 8,500,000 VND / $345; Team 20 16,000,000 VND / $650
- Paid plans: unlimited profiles, Veilus Flow, scheduling, batch runs, local REST API and MCP, Veilus Sync, script templates
- Lifetime includes updates forever and 3 years of support (renewal: 40% of the plan price per 3 years)
- More than 20 devices: contact us
- Buy: https://veilus.io/mua
